_note: NEW extension at v2026-08-25 (dev.ucp.common.loyalty; common/loyalty.json). No 04-08 equivalent existed. Extends catalog search, catalog lookup, cart, and checkout.

rows.requirement: A loyalty_membership object MUST include `id`, `name`, and `provisional`
rows.notes: Wholly new extension (dev.ucp.common.loyalty). No 04-08 equivalent existed.

rows.requirement: Programs that can be joined independently MUST be modeled as separate sibling entries under the loyalty map, distinguished by reverse-domain naming
rows.quote: Programs that can be joined independently MUST be modeled as separate sibling entries under the loyalty map, distinguished by reverse-domain naming (e.g., 'com.example.rewards' and 'com.example.rewards.card').
rows.notes: Checkable by confirming distinct, independently-verifiable programs never share one loyalty map key.

rows.requirement: All loyalty map keys MUST use reverse-domain naming to ensure provenance and prevent collisions when multiple extensions contribute to the shared namespace
rows.quote: All loyalty keys MUST use reverse-domain naming to ensure provenance and prevent collisions when multiple extensions contribute to the shared namespace.

rows.requirement: `display_id` MUST NOT be set if the membership has not been verified
rows.quote: MUST NOT be set if the membership has not been verified.
rows.notes: Cross-field check: display_id absent whenever provisional:true.

rows.requirement: Businesses MAY advertise loyalty support for any subset of catalog search, catalog lookup, cart, and checkout capabilities; Platforms SHOULD check which resources are extended
rows.quote:
Businesses MAY advertise loyalty
support for any subset of these capabilities. Platforms SHOULD check which resources are
extended.
rows.notes: Checkable against the business profile's dev.ucp.common.loyalty capability's `extends` array.

rows.requirement: Programs that can be joined independently MUST be modeled as separate sibling top-level keys in the loyalty extension map, namespaced by reverse-domain naming
rows.quote:
Programs that can be joined independently MUST be modeled as separate sibling entries
under the loyalty map, distinguished by their reverse-domain naming.

rows.requirement: When a business populates the loyalty extension from authenticated identity without an explicit eligibility claim, the map key MUST be the same reverse-domain identifier the business would accept as a claim value
rows.quote:
In this case, the map key MUST be the same reverse-domain
identifier the business would accept as a claim value.
rows.notes: Checkable by comparing the response's loyalty map key against the identifier the business documents/accepts as a context.eligibility claim value.

rows.requirement: When a business verifies a membership claim or determines membership from authenticated identity, it MUST return `provisional: false` and MUST populate the active tier(s) in `tiers` when the program has tier structure (tier-less programs MAY omit `tiers`)
rows.quote:
When a business verifies a membership claim or determines membership from
  authenticated identity, it MUST return `provisional: false`.
rows.notes: Directly checkable against the response's loyalty entry.

rows.requirement: When a membership claim is recognized and accepted but not verified, the business MUST return `provisional: true` and MUST NOT return `display_id` until the membership is verified
rows.quote:
When a membership claim in the request is recognized and accepted but not verified by
  the business, the business MUST return `provisional: true`.
rows.notes: Directly checkable against the response's loyalty entry.

rows.requirement: When a membership claim is accepted but cannot be verified, the business MUST communicate the failure via a recoverable message with `type: "error"` and `code: "eligibility_invalid"`
rows.quote:
the business
  MUST communicate the failure via a recoverable `message` with `type: "error"` and
  `code: "eligibility_invalid"`.
rows.notes: Directly checkable against messages[] (also demonstrated in the worked example at L415-451).

rows.requirement: At checkout completion, all accepted-but-unverified loyalty claims MUST be resolved per the Eligibility Verification at Completion contract
rows.quote:
At checkout completion, all accepted but unverified loyalty claims MUST be resolved per
the [Eligibility Verification at Completion](../../shopping/checkout/index.md#eligibility-verification-at-completion)
contract defined in the checkout capability.
rows.notes: Cross-references the (pre-existing, 04-08) Checkout eligibility-verification contract; the loyalty-specific binding to it is new.

rows.requirement: Businesses MUST evaluate conditions beyond membership (e.g. a minimum purchase threshold) before applying a monetary loyalty benefit
rows.quote:
Businesses
MUST evaluate those conditions before applying the benefit.
rows.notes: Checkable end-to-end by submitting a cart below/above a documented benefit threshold.

rows.requirement: When a monetary loyalty benefit applies, businesses MUST surface the price impact through the base capability's price fields (catalog price/list_price/price_range, or cart/checkout totals / line_items[].totals)
rows.quote:
When the benefit applies, businesses MUST surface the price impact through the base
capability's price fields.
rows.notes: Directly checkable against the response's totals/price fields.

rows.requirement: If a discount extension applied discount still requires verification because one or more accepted loyalty claims remain unverified, the corresponding applied discount MUST set `provisional: true`
rows.quote:
If the discount still
requires verification, for example because one or more accepted loyalty claims
remain unverified, the corresponding applied discount MUST set `provisional: true`.
rows.notes: Directly checkable against discounts.applied[].provisional cross-referenced with the loyalty entry's own provisional state.

rows.requirement: Businesses MUST NOT put inapplicable monetary loyalty benefits in the discount extension
rows.quote: Businesses MUST NOT put inapplicable benefits in the discount extension.
rows.notes: Checkable by confirming discounts.applied[] never contains a benefit the business separately reports as ineligible via `benefits`/messages.

rows.requirement: Loyalty extension response MUST be data-minimized and MUST NOT expose raw stable member identifiers, since that would allow the platform to uniquely identify individual buyers
rows.quote:
Loyalty extension response MUST be data-minimized and MUST NOT expose raw stable member
identifiers (as this would allow the platform to uniquely identify individual buyers).
rows.notes: Privacy-relevant; checkable by confirming `id` values are business-internal opaque identifiers rather than raw stable member/account numbers, and that only `display_id` (masked) is ever human-recognizable.

rows.requirement: Loyalty extension response MUST only include `display_id` after verified/authenticated memberships
rows.quote:
Loyalty extension response MUST only include `display_id` after verified/authenticated
memberships.
rows.notes: Directly checkable; restates LOY-004/LOY-009's display_id gating at the extension level.

rows.requirement: Loyalty extension response MUST treat all `context.eligibility` values in the request as buyer claims rather than proof
rows.quote:
Loyalty extension response MUST treat all `context.eligibility` values in the request as
buyer claims rather than proof.
rows.notes: Trust-boundary invariant; underpins the provisional/verified state machine (LOY-008/009/010).
